answer: Trust-graph random-walk ranking resists Sybil attacks in agent markets handling nebula imaging or orchard routing. Each agent enters as a vertex linked by stake-backed peer vouches, and short degree-normalized walks from seed anchors rank nodes for admission. Because flow across narrow attack cuts dilutes over fake clusters, each qualifying Sybil identity costs scarce bonded vouches from honest peers. However, bribed insiders or compromised anchors can still grant cheap attack edges.
